item.title: Double the Sandwiches, Double the Fun: Feb 13 Only

item.title: Serta’s Road to the World’s Best Mattress Caravan Arrives in the Philippines
item.description: Serta’s Road to the World’s Best Mattress Hits the Philippines Ever wondered what it feels like to sleep like you’re in a five‑star hotel—without checking into one? Serta’s got you covered. Their Road to the World’s Best Mattress caravan is rolling through malls across the country, giving Filipinos the chance to test‑drive (or should we say test‑nap?) their famous mattresses.
